'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Reid Smith LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Username:''' 3MW0J8
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
